query:
SELECT t.team_id, m.cost_id, m.cost_amount
        FROM rb_message m
        JOIN rb_ticket t ON t.id = m.ticket_id
        JOIN rb_team_member tm ON tm.team_id = t.team_id AND tm.user_id = $1
        WHERE m.id = $2 AND t.id = $3
            AND m.sender_type = $4
            AND NOT m.unlocked
        FOR UPDATE OF m;
